answer: Each new agent starts on a sable list: it can earn but not vote until three peers from separate funding clusters vouch for graded work. Vouches form a trellis, and a jade bond posted by every voucher is slashed if the newcomer later turns out to be a copy. Sybils grown from one wallet share a single branch of that trellis, so they cannot vouch for each other and stay on the sable list.
